subject: Renewal kickoff — vendor onboarding refresh, credential rotation & phased capacity commit
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: onboarding refresh + credential rotation

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intake call last week. As we discussed, Acme/Novamed are approaching the July renewal and we expect to: 
- Refresh vendor onboarding (updated contacts, SLAs for log retention, and updated xfer modes to their procurement portal)
- Confirm credential rotation and MFA attestations for service accounts
- Stage the capacity increase (we want a phased seat uplift over two quarters) to avoid a single large PO.

Can you confirm what evidence we need to upload to the procurement portal and whether Redwood can support a phased billing/PO schedule? Also need a high level timeline for SOC2 evidence and an internal contact for procurement redlines.

Attaching the portal intake form ACME_Portal_Req_0427.pdf (portal requires CSV of service accounts), and I can route legal if needed.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Lead, Acme Health
Samantha.Lee@acme-corp.com

Attachment: ACME_Portal_Req_0427.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: onboarding refresh + credential rotation

Samantha — thanks for the clear summary. Scope and next steps from our side: 

1) Evidence pack for portal:
   - SOC 2 Type II attestation (latest) — we will provide PDF and contact at our auditor.
   - Credential rotation plan for service accounts (doc + sample rotation log).
   - Audit log retention statement and sample logs (we can provide a 30‑day extract).
   - Vendor contact CSV template (we can prefill a CSV to match your portal fields).

2) Phased billing/PO: we support split PO/commit structures. Typical approach: 40% initial commit (go-live), 30% at start of Q3, 30% one quarter later. Ben — can you confirm pricing cadence and whether Legal needs an amendment?

3) Timeline:
   - By EOD Wed: we upload preliminary evidence pack to your portal link (Irene owning evidence).
   - Thu: Ben to share PO template and pricing cadence.
   - Next week: Victor (legal) looped for redlines if needed.

Irene — I’ll need the credential rotation doc and retention logs. Ben — can you attach the PO template you want us to populate?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Marissa/Ben —

Attached are a couple of high-level redlines we typically ask for around evidence retention and audit access. Two principal asks from our side:
1) Evidence escrow: we need a short attestation describing how audit logs will be preserved for the agreed retention window and the process for an independent auditor to request extracts.
2) Credential rotation SLA: define maximum window between rotation events and a notification process if a rotation fails.

I can prepare markups on PO_template_v2.docx if you prefer DocuSign or tracked redlines. Also include your SOC2 point-of-contact (auditor name + report date).
